pending_admission_location: Separate ledger; never the admitted manifest or a model execution input
missing_obligation_rule: Exclude from admitted manifest and mark PENDING_ADMISSION in the intake ledger

deterministic_example_id_profile.name: DIGISLEUTH_EXAMPLE_ID_v0.2_candidate
deterministic_example_id_profile.expression: ex_ + lowercase SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 JSON array [source_revision, input.sha256, reviewed_target.artifact.sha256, lineage_group.group_id]
deterministic_example_id_profile.serialization: Compact JSON array of four ASCII strings in the stated order, no whitespace or trailing LF
deterministic_example_id_profile.uniqueness: Globally unique across all three splits. A split change cannot disguise reuse of an example.

mandatory_checks_beyond_json_schema: Recompute each example_id with the bound profile; reject duplicate IDs even when other fields differ.
Verify every bound raw artifact digest, length and immutable source revision; compare snapshot SHA-256 to the exact source content.
Authenticate accepted target reviews against independently pinned reviewers and trust anchors; bind input, source, target, rubric, context and independence evidence.
Authenticate admission receipts and prior dependencies against the applicable recipient-local policy. Self-declared ADMITTED or VERIFIED values cannot substitute for this.
Resolve full lineage ancestry, semantic derivatives and known development fingerprints. Missing or disputed ancestry remains PENDING_ADMISSION.
Keep each transitive lineage group in exactly one split. Every repair-family origin or derivative and every known development case is restricted to regression_dev.
Validate split membership completeness, freeze exact manifest/membership and review identities, and authenticate the detached signature before any model/prompt/repair-cycle exposure.
Verify real holdout custody and access controls plus the exposure audit. A signed manifest does not by itself prove isolation or zero prior leakage.
schema_test_material: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; permanently excluded from fresh-holdout claims including derivatives
implemented_scope: JSON Schema structural guards only; full admission, authentication, ancestry and access-control mechanisms remain unbound
